title: Student Transportation Services Refund Schedule: Credited Share of the Permit Period by Last Day of Service
content:
On a family's own cancellation of a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit, the credited share of the permit period depends on when the last day of service falls and on the permit. The full-credit window is the fee table's 10 calendar days after the permit's start date, the start date being day 0.

| Last day of service and permit | Credited share |
|---|---|
| within 10 calendar days after the permit's start date, or the permit has no start date because service never began | one, the whole fee |
| later, on a Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | the whole calendar months of the permit period after the month of the last day, plus the month of the last day counted as one month (1) when the last day falls on or before the 10th day of the month, as half a month (0.5) when it falls on the 11th through the 20th day, and as nothing otherwise; all divided by the months the fee covers |
| later, on any other permit | the calendar days from the last day of service to the last day of the permit period, divided by the calendar days of the fee's span |

The months the fee covers are all 10 months of the school year (August through May) for a school-year fee posted before August 12, 2026, and otherwise the whole calendar months from the month the fee posted through May, that month included. The fee's span runs from the later of the period's first school day and the posting day to the period's last day.

## Both sides of the full-credit window (hypothetical start date August 12)

| Last day of service | Calendar days after the start date | Inside the window |
|---|---|---|
| August 22 | 10 | yes: share one |
| August 23 | 11 | no |

## Annual permit, fee covering 10 months (hypothetical last days)

| Last day of service | Whole months after that month | Month of the last day | Credited share |
|---|---|---|---|
| January 8 | 4 (February through May) | 1 | 5 divided by 10: 0.50 |
| January 15 | 4 | 0.5 | 4.5 divided by 10: 0.45 |
| January 25 | 4 | nothing | 4 divided by 10: 0.40 |
